name: QDRO Acquisition Corp. Units
summary: QDRO Acquisition Corp. functions as a Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC), established with the explicit goal of completing a significant corporate transaction. This could involve an amalgamation, asset acquisition, share exchange, or another form of business combination with one or more existing enterprises. Each of the company's investment units typically contains one Class A ordinary share along with a fractional redeemable warrant, the exact conditions of which are detailed in its official offering materials.
